About

Hi, I'm André, a Product Designer based in São Paulo, Brazil, with over 10 years of experience at companies like Itaú, Iti, Santander, OLX, HBO, Netflix, Melissa, and Centro Universitário Belas Artes.

As a Product Designer, my responsibility is to ensure the user experience is pleasant and efficient, aligning design with business goals to ensure product success.

I work on end-to-end development of digital products, going through discovery, research, ideation, UX, UI, design system, prototyping, handoff, final delivery, metrics tracking, and more. I use methodologies such as user research, interviews, competitive analysis, workshop facilitation, persona creation, user journey mapping, prototyping, A/B testing, usability testing, and tools like Figma, Miro, Maze, Hotjar, and GA.

I have experience in team coordination, mentoring, 1:1s, technical workshops, and also in hiring — handling candidate screening, interviews, and technical evaluations.
